p.t: In the Kitchen With Stefano Faita - What to Do With ... Avocados
p.d: Avocado tacos with pineapple-cucumber salsa; creamy avocado dressing; avocado Key lime pie.

p.t: Lidia's Kitchen - Eggs and My Chickens

p.t: In the Kitchen With Stefano Faita - What to do With... Coffee
p.d: Spicy rib eye steaks with maple coffee sauce; mocha coffee cake; espresso martini.
